newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile stocks end firm after some foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Chile stocks end firm after some foreign buying.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed broadly higher, buoyed by selective buying from foreign investors, dealers said.
But the rally has little solid support and the bolsa could waver and tilt lower again at Wednesday's opening, they said.
The 40-share index ended up 0.74 percent at 132.47 points. The general index rose 0.19 percent to 5,740.2 points.
Turnover rose to 11 billion pesos from 8.3 billion pesos Monday.
Traders said there were few buy orders before midday, but the tempo later picked up with spot buying from local investors.

Dealers said the market on Wednesday would pay close attention to the Wall Street debut of Quinenco, the holding company for the Luksic industrial group, as it launches American Depositary Receipts on the New York Stock Exchange.
"We think the placement will be a success as it is oversold in the internal market and there is great interest abroad," said one trader.
